missions.name: Three Forks sample depot
missions.description: Inspect the ten sample tubes Perseverance laid on the ground between December 2022 and January 2023 as a backup cache. Check each tube and photograph it. Position approximate.

missions.name: Ingenuity at Valinor Hills
missions.description: Survey the helicopter where it stopped after its 72nd and last flight in January 2024, with a broken rotor blade. Document its state without touching it. Position approximate.

missions.name: Mars 2020 descent stage
missions.description: Find the sky crane that lowered Perseverance on 18 February 2021 and then flew away to crash at a safe distance. Map the debris field. Position approximate.

missions.name: Jezero delta front
missions.description: Sample the layered sediments left by the river that once filled the crater lake. Position approximate.

missions.name: Jezero western rim
missions.description: Climb to the crater rim and sample the ancient crust lifted by the impact. Long traverse with a steady ascent. Position approximate.
